top_signals.title: Indonesia's Selloff Deepens With Officials set for MSCI Meeting
top_signals.summary: Indonesian markets extended their selloff, with stocks deepening their worst rout in almost 30 years and losses spreading to bonds and the rupiah after MSCI warned the country may face a two-step downgrade. Bloomberg's Anthony Stephens has more. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
